=== OPENAI === (6 findings — all reported 2026-10-01)
developers.openai.com/api/docs/changelog literal entry list: 09-29 Computer use in Agents
  API; 09-29 GPT-6.1 Sol; 09-29 Ultrafast mode (service_tier:"ultrafast"); 09-25 image
  encoding bugfix; 09-22 GPT-6 Sol + Luna.
learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog literal list now: 09-30 Codex CLI 0.159.3, 09-29 GPT-6.1
  Sol in Codex/ChatGPT Work, 09-29 Codex CLI 0.159.2, 09-29 0.159.1, 09-29 0.159.0,
  09-28 0.158.0, 09-26 0.157.1, 09-25 macOS 26.924, 09-25 0.157.0.
REPORTED:
  * Agents API (public beta 09-10). POST /v1/agents/sessions, header OpenAI-Beta: agents=v1.
    Objects: Agent / Environment / Session / Events-items. Subagents (<=4 concurrent in
    docs). MCP over HTTP. Code exec, file edit, shell. US-only. *** ZDR NOT SUPPORTED EVEN
    WITH A SELF-HOSTED SANDBOX. *** Session state retained server-side by OpenAI.
  * Computer use in Agents API. Approval type computer_use_approval_request /
    browser_origin_access is PER-ORIGIN ONLY — docs state it "does not enforce confirmation
    before individual actions". Credentials: browser_authentication request; email,
    password and verification CODES submitted through the SESSION EVENTS ENDPOINT. No
    passkeys, no QR. Screenshots returned to app.
  * Dots. GPT-6 Astra. Own cloud computer + browser. Runs while user offline. 4,000+ apps
    via already-connected plugins. Background subagents. 4-level Custom Rules, auto-review,
    mandatory human takeover for passwords/money. OFF BY DEFAULT, admin-enabled.
  * Local computer access (dots + Work Cloud). New "Agent Security" admin surface, Global
    baseline + per-environment override; approval policy and web-search mode are GLOBAL
    ONLY. Desktop 26.929+. AUDIT SPLIT: local executor -> customer OTel collector; cloud
    orchestration -> Compliance API; cloud OTel does NOT reach legacy collectors. MCP hooks
    give INCOMPLETE audit trails and callback failures DO NOT BLOCK the action.
    enforce_residency disables it. Unavailable on FedRAMP / EKM / UAE residency.
  * ChatGPT Space. Entities: Spaces, Members (permission levels), Agents incl. dots,
    Connectors, Files. @ChatGPT / @dot inline, comments, sidebar, slash commands.
  * Decisions API. GPT-6 Luna, fixed predefined answer set, text+image context. Positioned
    to "choose an agent's next action". LIMITED PREVIEW, NO PUBLIC SCHEMA YET. Announced GA
    on OpenAI API *and MICROSOFT FOUNDRY* — recheck Foundry side next scans.
NOT REPORTED (version/perf): GPT-6.1 Sol, service_tier "ultrafast", Responses API -45% TTFT,
  Codex CLI 0.159.x TUI/instant_interrupt changes.
UNMINED NEXT: the Agents API reference URL 404s
  (developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/beta/subresources/agents) — find the real
  reference path and extract the LITERAL operation list. Also unmined:
